answer: When trust hits its nadir after a clone flood, each close plants VRF-chosen honeypot answers with known-fail fingerprints into the attestation set. Any peer that seals one loses a 50,000 POA basalt bond and is banned 48 epochs. Standing up N fake identities means bonding N attestors (~50k each) and eating the expected honeypot hit (~1/8 of seals); cost scales linearly and compounds with bans. Failure mode: shared honeypot lists - rotate the trap corpus every epoch like a fresh sonnet and slash any seal on a retired trap.
